summary: Confirmed s1_design_quality_method_main_effect_llm_vs_triz_only. Read all 334 lines of the markdown conversion through the final references; the ten-page paper has no appendix. Checked PDF pp. 4-7 (printed pp. 510-513), including rendered Table 2 and Figure 4. PDF p. 6 (printed p. 512), Section 4.2 prints the design-quality Method main effect F(1, 108) = 3.21, p = .076. The Table 2 Total block prints the corresponding design-quality participant counts: TRIZ-C+LLM 63, TRIZ-C 51, and total 114. Parenthesized counts 62 and 113 refer to the student survey. The reported quote-not-found warning is a false positive: the PDF text layer encodes the visibly printed plus sign in TRIZ-C+LLM as U+0001. After replacing that control character with + and collapsing whitespace, the entire recorded counts quote matches the cited page exactly; all its numeric cells also match the rendered table. Confirmed question=with_ai, construct=usefulness, measure=expert_raters, unit=participant, higher_is=more_creative, outcome_with_ai=true, outcome_timing=immediate, within_person=null, comparison_type=ai_vs_active, and se_basis=participant. Each student was assigned one method and produced one final solution; expert ratings were averaged before analysis, and the control received the TRIZ contradiction-matrix aid. The pooled descriptive means and SDs are not adjusted arm levels for the reported two-way ANOVA Method effect; the paper prints no corresponding adjusted levels, signed contrast, SE, CI, or standardized effect. No additional in-scope outcome or full-sample contrast was found under extraction rules 4-6. Problem-specific simple effects and interactions are subgroup or moderation results; survey outcomes are self-reports. Separate statistics for the four design-quality components are not reported, the practice task was excluded, and the pilot supplies no eligible comparative output statistics.
